description: Issue #839 AC1, with ARITY as the discriminating variable: the two declarations of `scale` take one and two parameters, and the call `scale 1 2` matches only the LATER one. A last-wins override would run and print `2`; a first-wins rule would reach `ol-too-many-inputs`; the ruling's rule reports `ol-duplicate-definition` at the second declaration and runs nothing. A fixture whose two definitions were identical would pass under all three, which is why this one varies what the rule turns on.
